24716	    def test_buildspec_advertises_all_fields_read_by_production_code():
24717	        """Every ``spec.X`` and ``getattr(spec, "X", ...)`` reference in
24718	        production code (everything except this self-test) where the
24719	        enclosing function declares ``spec: BuildSpec`` (or
24720	        ``Optional[BuildSpec]``) must name a declared BuildSpec dataclass
24721	        field, so the dataclass stays in sync with the code that consumes
24722	        it.
24723	
24724	        This is the structural guardrail that lets us drop the historical
24725	        ``getattr(spec, ...)`` fallbacks in favour of plain ``spec.X``
24726	        attribute access: a future rename of a BuildSpec field will now
24727	        hard-fail at this check rather than silently regressing to the
24728	        ``getattr`` default.
24729	
24730	        Functions that take a ``spec`` parameter with a different (or no)
24731	        annotation are skipped — they may be duck-typed callers (e.g.
24732	        ``apply_to_buildspec``) that intentionally use ``getattr`` for
24733	        graceful absent-field handling.
24734	        """
24735	        import ast as _ast
24736	        from dataclasses import fields as _fields
24737	        with open(__file__, "r", encoding="utf-8") as _f:
24738	            tree = _ast.parse(_f.read())
24739	        # Locate the self-test function so we can exclude it.
24740	        self_test_start = self_test_end = None
24741	        for node in _ast.walk(tree):
24742	            if isinstance(node, _ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "_self_test":
24743	                self_test_start = node.lineno
24744	                self_test_end = node.end_lineno
24745	                break
24746	        assert self_test_start is not None, "could not locate _self_test"
24747	
24748	        # Collect (start_line, end_line) ranges of every function whose
24749	        # `spec` parameter is annotated as BuildSpec / Optional[BuildSpec].
24750	        def _annotation_names_buildspec(ann) -> bool:
24751	            if ann is None:
24752	                return False
24753	            s = _ast.unparse(ann)
24754	            # Strip Optional[...] wrappers.
24755	            for prefix in ('Optional[', 'Union['):
24756	                if s.startswith(prefix) and s.endswith(']'):
24757	                    s = s[len(prefix):-1]
24758	            # Strip quoted forward refs.
24759	            s = s.strip("'\"")
24760	            return s.endswith("BuildSpec")
24761	
24762	        ranges: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
24763	        for node in _ast.walk(tree):
24764	            if isinstance(node, (_ast.FunctionDef, _ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
24765	                all_args = list(node.args.args) + list(node.args.kwonlyargs)
24766	                for arg in all_args:
24767	                    if arg.arg == "spec" and _annotation_names_buildspec(
24768	                            arg.annotation):
24769	                        ranges.append((node.lineno, node.end_lineno))
24770	                        break
24771	
24772	        def _in_buildspec_fn(lineno: int) -> bool:
24773	            return any(s <= lineno <= e for s, e in ranges)
24774	
24775	        declared = {f.name for f in _fields(BuildSpec)}
24776	        names_read: Dict[str, List[int]] = {}
24777	        for node in _ast.walk(tree):
24778	            lineno = getattr(node, "lineno", -1)
24779	            if lineno < 0:
24780	                continue
24781	            if self_test_start <= lineno <= self_test_end:
24782	                continue
24783	            if not _in_buildspec_fn(lineno):
24784	                continue
24785	            # spec.X attribute access
24786	            if (isinstance(node, _ast.Attribute)
24787	                    and isinstance(node.value, _ast.Name)
24788	                    and node.value.id == "spec"):
24789	                names_read.setdefault(node.attr, []).append(lineno)
24790	            # getattr(spec, "X", ...) call
24791	            elif (isinstance(node, _ast.Call)
24792	                    and isinstance(node.func, _ast.Name)
24793	                    and node.func.id == "getattr"
24794	                    and len(node.args) >= 2
24795	                    and isinstance(node.args[0], _ast.Name)
24796	                    and node.args[0].id == "spec"
24797	                    and isinstance(node.args[1], _ast.Constant)
24798	                    and isinstance(node.args[1].value, str)):
24799	                names_read.setdefault(node.args[1].value, []).append(lineno)
24800	        undeclared = {
24801	            name: lines for name, lines in names_read.items()
24802	            if name not in declared and not name.startswith("__")
24803	        }
24804	        assert not undeclared, (
24805	            f"{len(undeclared)} attribute name(s) read off `spec` in "
24806	            f"production code (in functions where spec: BuildSpec) but NOT "
24807	            f"declared on the BuildSpec dataclass: {undeclared}")
24808
